svg.title: Taurine: seven human trials worth knowing
svg.desc: Taurine: seven human trials worth knowing. Cirrhosis fatigue, 2026, 220 people, Open-label: Main goal missed. Hip fracture, older adults, 2015, 236 people, Placebo: No fewer complications or deaths. Prehypertension, 2016, 120 people, Placebo: Blood pressure lower. Biological-age trial, 2024-25, 90 people, Placebo: Finished; no results posted. Women 55 to 70, 2022, 24 people, Placebo: Antioxidant marker held. Heart failure, 1985, 14 people, Placebo, crossover: Symptoms improved. MELAS, Japan, 2019, 10 people, Open-label: 6 of 10 had no episodes.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 714 people in total. Most trials were small and lasted 4 weeks to 1 year.
